criteria.title: Durable task lifecycle
criteria.finding: Task state and conversation/session separation have persistent Store, historical executable recovery and installed restart/restore proof. Verify final historical-task-recovery and all current workspace results before closure.

criteria.title: Narrow current authority
criteria.finding: Task/invocation authority, current parent revocation, wrong task/cid/recipient/provider binding and replay are controlled adversarial checks. The actual Vapi rehearsal is task-bound, but does not replace negative fixtures. Final T-A1/T-A2 source-linked matrix remains required.

criteria.title: Explicit reply routing
criteria.finding: Task-bound journal reply assignment and ambiguous SMS handling are explicit. The final actual Codex draft has two tasks in one conversation; only task A receives the reply and one attributed follow-up, while task B remains waiting. The model-facing reply reference uses the received conversation event, not source/message/question/task-event IDs.

criteria.title: Durable resume and one logical effect
criteria.finding: Actual exact-session continuation preserves draft bytes and one follow-up. Competing workers, commit/ACK crash ordering and unknown remote acceptance are separately tested; uncertainty is retained without blind redispatch. Final current-source recovery/runner results are required.

criteria.title: Source-backed bounded recall
criteria.finding: Controlled bounded recall tests cover older-than-projection context, current authorization, source provenance, retention and malicious text. Actual Vapi voice uses an unspoken prior day/time/code; its decision is retained and used in post-restart chat. Missing end report leaves completeness explicitly incomplete.

criteria.title: SMS task eligibility and suppression
criteria.finding: Actual reviewed handset HELLO/HELP/STOP/START and signed callback evidence is retained on 9abf38f. STOP blocks queued/new provider sends and replay; START keeps old jobs cancelled and permits one new eligible mutation. Current-source dispatch/source composition must establish continued policy equivalence.

criteria.title: One researched, installed additional host
criteria.finding: Codex CLI 0.162.0-alpha.17.2 is the selected researched host. Supplied install assets/skill/MCP load on normal installed 7edb1b1; actual model turns resume exact saved sessions without reconstructed context. Explicit developer resume and protected short-lived grant renewal are disclosed. Other assistant names remain research outcomes.

criteria.title: MCP, skill and public-interface parity
criteria.finding: The extracted package qualifies public SDKs, native helper, HTTP/JSON facade, skill assets and installed host use. Current MCP lifecycle/tool/catalog/session controls and language parity remain separate controlled workspace checks; only the normal helper is the native QUIC path.

criteria.title: Vapi invokes Connect tools in chat and voice
criteria.finding: Real Vapi voice and post-restart chat invoke Connect MCP with actual provider receipts. Read-only retained setup/grant rows confirm distinct verified call/chat-session bindings to the original task. Model tool receipts contain the original step/request/effect identities. Controlled fixtures qualify forgery, expiry and replay.

criteria.title: Agent-presence follow-through
criteria.finding: Actual installed Codex authors two draft artifacts/questions, preserves bytes/digests through server restart, adopts renewed narrow authority without replacing its sessions, then produces one source-backed follow-up only for the answered task. Independent incoming contact uses the supplied example and a fact not repeated in its request.

criteria.title: Connected app in both directions
criteria.finding: Independent public-SDK app artifacts, review decisions and intake tickets use a separate application database and public clients. Both directions, rejected identities, crash-before-ACK, duplicate requests/replies and one business effect have mapped controlled proof. Final workspace/example/recovery checks must requalify those sources.

criteria.title: Cross-channel task and conversation continuity
criteria.finding: Actual native UCTP/QUIC audio passes through local Connect to Vapi WebSocket, uses the prior fact, journals a sourced decision, ends its bounded session and continues via a new Vapi chat invocation plus delivered SMS after restart in the same task/conversation. Sibling task unchanged; isolation/deleted-context adversaries are controlled fixtures.

criteria.title: Bounded waiting and observable recovery
criteria.finding: Tool/MCP deadlines and declared task, grant, queue, payload and lifecycle limits have independent profiles and truthful pending/effect status. Voice model delivery inference is explicitly limited; later chat actually observes its exact effect pending then succeeded. Complete current profiles and diagnostics are required before closure.

criteria.title: Reproducible candidate and evidence closure
criteria.finding: Final acceptance must reconcile the clean 5d full runner, normal installed 7ed candidate, actual model/provider source versions and integration delta. Preserve earlier failed/partial runs, exact archive/binary digests, current-source authority/limits/recovery proof and all 36 item dependencies. Local owner review does not publish v0.1 or start Gate 5.
